# Workable | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Continuous recruitment for multiple positions | Continuous multi-post recruitment is validated using the main link “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - employee manager self-help - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| global job distribution | The main link to validate global job distribution is “People or candidate data entry-rule or approval processing-Staff Manager self-help-results access report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Recruiting | Induction is validated on the basis of the main link, “People's or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Integration of HRIS for SMEs | The main link to validate the integration of HRIS for SMEs is “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
